title: Stepping Down From Twenty One, The Fed Coin Flip & The AI Credit Bubble
takeaway: Mallers' first show since leaving 21 as CEO — an unusually honest post-mortem on why he stepped down (no board control), plus his read on the Fed coin-flip, the AI credit bubble, and a renewed mission to educate the world on Bitcoin.

title: Bitcoin is Forever Money
podcast: The Peter McCormack Show (What Bitcoin Did)
takeaway: Saylor makes the case for bitcoin as the treasury asset that beats the S&P cost-of-capital, and argues the best thing bitcoin can do is stay boring: ossify, protect user rights, and not let regulation break it.

title: Michael Saylor on BTC at $100K and the Future of MicroStrategy
takeaway: Recorded right after bitcoin crossed $100k: Saylor on the strategic-reserve push, why public proof-of-reserves matters, and how MicroStrategy keeps issuing equity to stack sats.

title: The Future of Bitcoin w/ Michael Saylor
takeaway: Saylor on why bitcoin will never fail, responsible 'hard asset' allocation for long-term holders, and what to expect from the halving cycle.

title: BTC235: Jack Mallers on XXI and Strike Borrowing & Lending
takeaway: Mallers on Twenty One (the publicly traded vehicle for investing in bitcoin), over-collateralized Strike lending with no rehypothecation, and why bitcoin is the collapse-proof answer to the unraveling post-WWII monetary order.

title: #222: Beefing with the NFL
podcast: TFTC — Tales from the Crypt (Marty Bent & Matt Odell)
takeaway: Mallers on athletes getting paid in sats, Strike global remittance, the state of the Lightning Network, and routing around the traditional rails.

title: Is Hyperinflation Coming? With Preston Pysh
takeaway: Pysh on the end of the long-term debt cycle: credit that only works via ever-increasing dollar debasement, and how a Bitcoin standard changes the economic order.

title: 99. How Fiat Money Works
takeaway: A deep dive with Saifedean on The Fiat Standard — how fiat 'solved' gold's space problem, got captured by governments, and now destroys wealth through inflation and kills economic calculation.

title: 126. Staying Humble & Stacking Sats with Matt Odell
takeaway: Odell on shrinking the attack surface for self-custody: minimize internet-connected signing, consider multisig for big stacks, and the overwhelming case against trading — stay humble and stack.

title: BTC044: Bitcoin Privacy w/ Matt Odell
takeaway: Odell on layered Bitcoin privacy, why big social platforms are a sovereignty threat, and what Lightning and mining privacy actually look like in practice.

title: Rabbit Hole Recap — weekly series
takeaway: A steady weekly calibration: ODELL and Marty recap the week's bitcoin news — self-custody, hardware, protocol, and industry drama — with the signal-to-noise you expect from these two.
